ww.name: Water treatment
ww.lede: Size an activated sludge plant (the published ASM1 model) or work the design equations, then put each basin on the site from its volume and water depth. A study aid, not an engineering approval: the ASM1 constants are typed and not yet checked by an engineer.
ww.place: Put the basins on the site
ww.placed: Put {n} basin outlines on the site as feature lines (one undo step). Square placeholders: the shape and the place are yours.
ww.norun: Run the activated sludge calculator first: there are no basins to place.
ww.engine.held: is not offered yet: its licence waits on the owner and no script ships for it.
ww.engine.ok: can run through CadCraft Studio when it is installed on this computer.
ww.settler: Settler: sludge blanket {h} m of {H} m (layers at or above {th} g/m3), effluent solids {x} g/m3, underflow {u} g/m3.
ww.settler.key: Layers from the bottom up, solids on a log scale; the feed layer is in colour, the blanket shaded.
calc.lede: Pick a calculator, edit the sample input, and run it. A calculation aid, not an engineering approval: typed constants are marked for review.
calc.badjson: The input is not valid JSON: {why}
calc.option.pick: Choose a fitting from the draft table…
